title: Lean language server: goals, tactics and Mathlib search
when: seeing the goals before and after a line of the proof, or the type expected at a position, without a whole lean_check
trying several tactics at one line and seeing which of them close the goal
finding Mathlib lemmas by name, by type pattern or by what they say, or premises for a goal
whenNot: deciding whether a proof is right: only lean_check accepts a proof
reading or changing any other file of the project
running code, building the project, or anything else than the eight operations

op.description: goal: the goals at a line or a position; term_goal: the expected type at a position; diagnostics: Lean's messages on the file; multi_attempt: several tactics tried at one line; loogle: Mathlib by name or type pattern; leansearch: Mathlib by meaning; state_search: lemmas for the goal at a position; hammer_premise: premises for the goal at a position

fullName.description: Fully qualified name of the target theorem

declaredName.description: Its name as written in the source

prefix.description: The file before the first marker line

header.description: The docstring, attributes and the declaration up to its `by`

originalProof.description: The proof the regions start with

suffix.description: The file after the last marker line

sketch.description: Harness use. The problem's sketch (the Sketch of @seshat/core), which the file operations build the file from. The harness fills it in for a prover's calls, and a prover cannot set it.

aux.description: The whole AUX region, as for lean_check. Default: the AUX of your last lean_check.

proof.description: The whole PROOF region, without `by`, as for lean_check. Default: the PROOF of your last lean_check.

region.description: The region that line counts in (default proof); for diagnostics, the only region to report on

line.description: goal, term_goal, multi_attempt, state_search, hammer_premise: a line of the region, from 1, as lean_check numbers them

column.description: A character position in the line as it stands in the file (proof lines start with the harness's indentation), from 1. Optional: goal then gives the goals before and after the line

tactics.description: multi_attempt: tactics to try in place of the line, each one or several lines. A tactic replaces as many lines as it has, from `line`, and must end inside the region

query.description: loogle: a name, a type pattern or a conclusion; leansearch: what the lemma says

limit.description: loogle, leansearch, state_search, hammer_premise: how many results at most (defaults 8, 5, 5, 16)

severity.description: diagnostics: only messages of this level

timeoutSec.description: goal, state_search, diagnostics: how long Lean may take to elaborate the file, in seconds, before the answer says it is still elaborating

status.description: ok; goal with a column: goals, complete, no_goal_here or still_elaborating; term_goal: no_term_goal; diagnostics: partial; state_search and hammer_premise: complete or no_goal_here; any search: unavailable

lineText.description: The line asked about, as it stands in the file

goals.description: goal at a position: the goals there

goalsBefore.description: goal on a line: the goals before it

goalsAfter.description: goal on a line: the goals after it

region.description: fixed: outside both regions, and then line is the file's

column.description: from 1, in the line as it stands in the file

category.description: linter, sorry or suggestion; absent for an ordinary message

hint.description: the server's advice for a failure it recognizes

result.description: closed: no goal left and no error

region.description: fixed: outside both regions, and then line is the file's

column.description: from 1, in the line as it stands in the file

category.description: linter, sorry or suggestion; absent for an ordinary message

hint.description: the server's advice for a failure it recognizes

goal.description: state_search: the goal that was searched for

more.description: Items the answer does not show

unavailable.description: A site that could not be asked, and why; the rest of the answer is empty

examples.title: the goals before and after a line

implementations.description: lean-lsp-mcp 0.31.0 (PyPI) as a child process over stdio, by default started with uvx, on a Lean project: 8 of its 22 tools behind an allowlist, the other 14 switched off in the server (LEAN_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS) and never called. The harness writes one scratch file per attempt in the project and names no other file. Not sandboxed: the server and Lean run as the harness's user (documentation/lean-lsp.md). The searches ask Loogle, LeanSearch, Lean Finder and a premise server over the network. Not run against a real Lean yet.
